name: IC Driver Motor — 3.3V, I2C — QFN
description: Surface-mount 3.3V I2C motor driver IC cluster in QFN packages containing two KiCad symbol parts across tier A and tier B quality levels.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a 3.3V I2C motor driver IC in an SMD QFN package family.
Choose EMC2303-x-KP for tier A quality in a VQFN-12 footprint or EMC2305-x-AP for tier B in a VQFN-16 footprint.
Verify PCB footprint requirements for VQFN-12 or VQFN-16 package variants.
avoid_when: The design requires non-SMD mounting rather than QFN packages.
Operating voltage is not 3.3V or communication interface is not I2C.
Footprint options VQFN-12 and VQFN-16 are incompatible with the board layout.
